body:
## DM-268 attempt 2 (fix round) evidence detail (worker)
Builds on comment cm_01m7j5pr45btcc6a5g97h7hcq3 (attempt 1 criterion->test map and mutation record, still valid except where changed below).

### Rejection items
1. **B1 (71bca88)** hostAttribution.ts:166 now `inWindow(pass, thread.startedAt) && inWindow(pass, at)`; note/doc updated. New test hostAttribution.test.ts 'a run-1 worker thread still writing under its run-1 claim after run 2 starts stays in run 1 only (81000 + 25000 = the 106000 spent)'; existing 'a worker thread reused by run 2 ... 116000' still passes. Mutations: drop sample half -> reused-thread test fails; drop start half -> new test fails. Reviewer hostB.ts: 81,000 + 25,000 = 106,000 spent, run2 unattributed null.
2. **B2 (6979e95)** observations.ts: forward same-call citations allowed; only cycles refused (refuseCitationCycles, invalid_input with details.cycle), self-citation still refused. Tests observations.test.ts 'DM-170 c2: observations of one call cite each other in any order, never in a cycle' (earlier/later accepted; mutual refused {cycle:[1,2,1]} nothing stored; 3-cycle refused; diamond not a cycle) and 'DM-170 c2 with DM-175: a defect withdrawal may precede its report in one call' (real escaped_defect shape, resolveDefects -> withdrawn, not counted); observationRecords.test.ts 'a forward citation chain of one call imports cleanly on another machine' (importer unchanged). Mutations: skip cycle check -> both cycle tests fail; `at >= 0` -> `> 0` -> mutual test fails.
3. **Timing (31279ef)** timingActivity.ts preferHost: an agent span (active or wait) keeps only time the host reported nothing for (host active or wait, same identity/actor); host cover memoised. timing.ts: priority host active > host wait > agent active > agent wait; each segment's evidence names its source. Tests timing.test.ts 'DM-172 c1/c3: an agent self-report fills only time the host reported nothing for (review P1-P3)': P1 active 20, queue 10, effort 20 (all host); P2 host/agent/host/agent segments, active 30; P3 agent/host/agent, active 30, effort worker 24 + other 6 = 30. Reviewer timingA.ts reproduces these. Mutations: metric back in hostKeys -> P1 fails; every active layer labelled host -> P2/P3/overlap tests fail.
4. **Coverage gaps**: rubric.test.ts 'DM-169 c3: E needs at least 80% of effort classified, never imputed' (exactly 80% scores, 79.9999% missing insufficient_classification) — `<` -> `<=` at rubric.ts:423 fails 'exactly 80% classified scores E' (e085ccb). plannedBaselines.test.ts 'DM-171 c3: a budget applies only when frozen strictly before dispatch' (same ms -> none; 1 ms earlier -> frozen 20,000) — `<` -> `<=` at plannedBaselines.ts:164 fails the same-ms test (2582706). Linearity: timingIntervals.ts exports an operation counter `intervalWork`; timing.test.ts 'DM-172 performance: interval work grows linearly (operation counts, no clock)' asserts work(20k) <= 2.2 x work(10k) on four shapes. It caught a real quadratic in the attempt-1 preferHost fix (ratio 3.99, ~25 s at 20k), fixed by memoising the host cover.

### Checks
20 new/touched test files, 712 tests pass (also shuffled, seed 777); npx oxlint on every added/modified src file 0 findings; npm run typecheck clean. Full npm test, coverage, build, deadcode and Fireguard left to the full check sweep (npm run deadcode already lists many pre-existing SPACE exports on this branch; intervalWork is not among them).
